packageRules.description: Vuetify 4 per docs/adr/0031; no major upgrade without a decision.
The package name typescript is an alias of the TypeScript 6 API for typescript-eslint and vue-tsc; tsc itself is TypeScript 7 (@typescript/native), see docs/adr/0001.
RKE2 versions carry the release number after '+' (v1.35.9+rke2r1).
k0s versions carry the release number after '+' (v1.35.8+k0s.1).
Kubernetes catalogs keep one entry per minor: report patches of that minor separately.

customManagers.description: versions.yaml: every version the app pins (FP-20, ADR-0018).
